key_rules: Always CC Karlien (plessers.karlien@qualico.be) on ALL operational emails
Cashflow: wait as long as possible to pay partners — never rush payments
Query Supabase at runtime for ALL data — never assume or hardcode
Use Shared_Knowledge (capital S, capital K, double-quoted) for dynamic state
PO values in USD (total_value_usd); cashflow baseline EUR; USD_TO_EUR = 0.88
Always use practical_volume_cbm from Container_Standards, NEVER gross_volume_cbm
Container fill: always apply 4% buffer on practical_volume_cbm
Amazon TOs: ALWAYS separate MATS vs TRAYS (different FCs)
Bol TOs: ALWAYS separate Regulier vs XL — check bol_lvb_category
Never activate Bol NL and Bol BE simultaneously
Tijdelijke actieprijs NOT possible via Bol Retailer API — must use Playwright
Bol.com pricing: always use tijdelijke actieprijs (sales price), NOT regular price
TOs: NEVER hard-delete — use soft delete (status = Cancelled)
COGS updates: do NOT overwrite cogs_usd without WAC calculation
Monta uses EAN as SKU/product identifier (not internal SKU names)
Delivery date MANDATORY when creating TOs — always set eta_fc
Pallet optimization: ALWAYS snap to full pallets — query Product_Pallet_Config
GLC WMS: use Available Qty (not On Hand) — Available = On Hand - Allocated
Slack: only post NEW actionable content from external partners — never internal emails
No logging to Supabase Emails_Processed_Qualico — local SQLite dedup only
Floormax scope: only confirm ex factory dates — never ask for container/ETD/booking
PI change → payment hold: confirm previous payment credited before paying updated PI
Flieber inventory sheets: only update rows where column D has a label
